critical_code_review_comments: DraftRoomBottomGrid.tsx: props `undraftedOnly` / `setUndraftedOnly` used but not destructured — classic React 'variable not defined' regression when a new prop is added to only one of the two places. Consider adding a prop-types or TS type (currently @ts-nocheck) to catch this at build time.
Backend `/api/waivers/available?limit=5000` returns 500 — endpoint should either cap limit gracefully or validate + 4xx instead of throwing. Not blocking this iteration but a latent robustness bug.

Backend eligible-players endpoint returned identical counts with and without `undrafted_only=true` (1338 vs 1338) because the draft already has `exclude_previously_drafted=True`. The redundant filter is safe but the frontend `Undrafted only` toggle on the Eligible tab is effectively a no-op for this draft — worth documenting.

rca_of_the_issue: DraftRoomBottomGrid.tsx line 52-53 references `undraftedOnly` and `setUndraftedOnly`, but the function signature at lines 25-38 does not destructure them from props. Because the file is `@ts-nocheck`, TypeScript did not catch this. Parent DraftRoom.tsx (lines 816-817) correctly passes both props. Fix: add `undraftedOnly, setUndraftedOnly,` to the destructured props between `typeFilter, setTypeFilter,` (line 28) and `positions,` (line 29). Reproduction: navigate to /draft-room with valid draftId and leagueId — page renders the error boundary with message 'undraftedOnly is not defined'.
